paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
notes: Ferromagnetic haloscope (QUAX) prototype. Sets upper limit g_aee < 4.9e-10 at 95% C.L. for axion mass 58 ueV (14 GHz). The exclusion is over a ~3 MHz scan range around 14 GHz, but only the central minimum value is reported numerically in text. Fig. 8 shows the excluded band but no tabulated values are given.
